new_interesting_lines: * '''Scout's Sentry''' - Evasive like ''Barricade'' will deal more critical hits, evade more consistently denying power from the attacker.
* Anyone who relies on special attacks - Bots who rely on special attacks to do real damages like [[Demolition]] bots will take damage if they have Backfire debuffs but make sure you dodge the hits!
* [[Hot Rod]] - Decelerations will leave the rouge cop unable to evade attacks.
* [[Laser Guidance Module]] - Barricade will be able to make greater use of his Backfire and Heavy Attacks.

Avoid Barricade's ranged attacks by sidestepping frequently, as they can land critical hits and Backfire. Be careful not to use Special Attacks if under the effect of Backfire, or else it will backfire by potentially knocking yourself out. If possible, do not knock him down with Heavy Attacks, as his Evade is one of if not the highest rates.

In return Megatron provides 2~3~8% Armor. ==Strategy== ===Commander=== Stay at a distance and keep inflicting backfire debuffs. You can also deal more melee damage with your criticals. ===Opponent=== ==== General ==== Avoid Barricade's ranged attacks by sidestepping frequently, as they can land critical hits and Backfire. Be careful not to use Special Attacks if under the effect of Backfire, or else it will backfire by potentially knocking yourself out. If possible, do not knock him down with Heavy Attacks, as his Evade is one the the highest rates. ==== Rulers of Kaon ==== If you thought [[Sideswipe]] was slippery, there's Barricade with his evade ranged timed mod. To save you time, bring a formidable anti-evasion Warrior with your party. Otherwise, Barricade plays like any other Barricade fight. ===Strong Match-ups=== * [[Ratchet]] - Inflicting Backfires will deal more damage than the Autobot Medic can heal. * [[Demolition]] bots who rely on special attacks will take damage if they have Backfire debuffs. Make sure you dodge the hits! *[[Megatron (ROTF)]] - Stacking backfires will ignore Megatron’s tough armor. Sometimes Leaders can fall. * [[Grimlock]] - Stacking backfires will ignore his Signature ability. Sometimes a king can fall. ===Weak Match-ups=== * [[Hound]] - Autobot Hound’s Precision Ammo rarely misses, making him the premier choice to dismantle this Barricade’s powerful Evasion Buff. * [[Hot Rod]]'s ranged attacks will leave the rouge cop unable to evade attacks. * [[Megatronus]] - The relic of obedience can prevent the bad cop from gaining buffs whenever he is knocked down. ===Recommended Modules === The Bad Cop is giving you trouble with these Mods! '''This need edit!''' * The [[Laser Guidance Module]] will enable him to make greater use of his Backfire and Heavy Attacks. * [[Nightbird's Mark]] - The elusive Barricade will be evading more attacks along with an increased critical rate'''.''' * S'''cout's Sentry''' - Evasive like ''Barricade'' will deal more critical hits, evade more consistently denying power from the attacker. ==Obtainment== * Bot Crystals * Cinematic Crystal * Barricade Arenas * Corruption Crystal * June 2019 Bot Chip Set ==Gallery== Barricade.jpg Barricade Icon.jpg Barricade Icon New.jpg Barricade portrait.png Barricade portrait New.png Barricade Icon v3.jpg Barricade portrait v3.png 2-Star_Cinematic_Crystal_banner.jpg 3-Star_Cinematic_Crystal_banner.jpg Premium_Cinematic_Crystal_banner.jpg Ultimate_Cinematic_Crystal_banner.jpg Shattered Lenses 5 master.jpg Corruption Crystal banner.jpg == Updates == * With the Rank 6 update, his Critical Damage rates start from tier 3 at rank 1, instead of tier 2's 79%. * Rank 3 Evade was labelled 72% in old versions. == Trivia == * His vehicle mode is based on the 2006 Customized Saleen S281E, but the logo is removed to avoid licensing issues. ==External Links== [[Category:Bots]] [[Category:Decepticons]] [[Category:Cinematic]] [[Category:Cinematic Decepticons]] [[Category:Scout]] [[Category:1-Star Bots]] [[Category:5-Star Bots]] [[Category:Dark Of The Moon]] [[Category:MV1]] [[Category:DOTM]] [[Category:TLK]] [[Category:The Last Knight]] [[Category:2-Star Bots]] [[Category:3-Star Bots]] [[Category:4-Star Bots]]
